note: Pre-registered task set. FREEZE = committed to git. Do NOT edit after timing begins — freezing the set is what stops post-hoc cherry-picking. Each task must be answerable BOTH from source (condition A, cold / no KB) and from the KB (condition B, Mnemox mode loaded). No-leakage guard: verify the KB digest B relies on was written by PRIOR/general sessions, not seeded with this task's answer for the test; if a task's specific answer was written into the KB *for* this test, that task is invalid.

conditions.A: cold / no KB — fresh Bob session, KB not loaded; Bob re-derives context from source
conditions.B: with KB — Bob session with the Mnemox knowledge-manager mode loaded; Bob retrieves from the KB

order_note: `order` is the pre-recorded A-first/B-first counterbalance (prevents the second run winning from learning effects). The alternating default below is a valid pre-registration; an operator may substitute their own coin-flip order as long as it is recorded here BEFORE timing.
